answer: Weight votes by a anchor of distinct paying clients rather than by seat count: every identity must present a voyage-verified ledger of outside demand settled through it, and its summit of influence is the square root of that demand, capped per human it can prove. A farm splitting into 500 seats divides the same client revenue into 500 roots, so total weight peaks at one seat per client base, while a funded farm would have to fake revenue that is checked against client signatures.
